content.tldr: The team welcomed new front-end engineer Nico and discussed process updates including async issue weighting, removing weekend on-call shifts, and improving the back-end weekly call.

bullets.text: Nicolo Maria Mezzanzanica (Nico) joined the package team as a new front-end engineer.
The team will use Issue Herder for T-shirt sizing estimates by October 16 to finalize the next milestone.
A proposal is underway to remove weekend on-call requirements from the infra-dev escalation process.
GitLab may increase hiring across the organization during Q4.
John Mason introduced Nicolo Maria Mezzanzanica (Nico) as the team's newest front-end engineer.
Nico previously worked at PuyLab and maintains open-source Vue.js packages.
Dan Jensen outlined a plan to complete T-shirt sizing for issues by October 16.
The team will finalize deliverables on October 17 before starting the new milestone on October 18.
John Mason offered to provide demos of the Issue Herder tool for team members.
Steve Abrams reminded the team that daylight savings changes at the end of October may affect meeting times.
Dan Jensen emphasized that members missing meetings should watch the recordings the next day to stay connected.
Dan Jensen shared a discussion about removing weekend on-call shifts from the infra-dev escalation process.
The change addresses legal considerations regarding unpaid weekend work in certain countries.
Gigi is reviewing a large community contribution for the Composer PHP package manager.
Dan Jensen is following the merge request to ensure the community contribution receives proper support.
Axel Boldt-Christmas created a merge request to consolidate and improve navigation for package features.
The team is encouraged to review the merge request and provide feedback.
Dan Jensen encouraged back-end engineers to attend the weekly call held at UTC-7.
The organization plans to invest more in the back-end call by adding tips, tricks, and social elements.
John Mason suggested adopting monthly social themes similar to the front-end team's process.
Dan Jensen asked the team to review the Issue Herder tool and provide feedback on the weighting process.
Team members are requested to add their daylight savings dates to the agenda.
Team members should review Axel's navigation merge request and provide feedback.
Engineering managers will meet soon to help seed content for the back-end weekly calls.

content.tldr: The package team discussed lightweight issue sizing, navigation improvements, and updates on community contributions like the composer package manager. They also welcomed new team member Nico.
